name: Snipes Mountain
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

notes: Young Sangiovese plantings here have given spicy, tart cherry wines with anise, red currant and tobacco leaf.

blurb.text: A small Washington AVA of about 4,145 acres near Outlook in the Yakima Valley, the state's third smallest. It holds some of the state's oldest vineyard plantings, and Chardonnay, Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot are its top grapes.
